name: Ferdinand Hodler
bio: Ferdinand Hodler was a Swiss painter. He is one of the best-known Swiss painters of the nineteenth century. His early works were portraits, landscapes, and genre paintings in a realistic style. Later, he adopted a personal form of Symbolism which he called "parallelism".

paintings.title: The Dream of the Shepherd
paintings.story: The Dream of the Shepherd is an oil on canvas painting by Swiss artist Ferdinand Hodler, from 1896. It depicts a shepherd kneeling in a field while dreaming of nude women.
facts: Dream was acquired by the Metropolitan Museum of Art in 2013 and remains in the Met's collection.
Unlike his previous, more realist works, Dream shows Hodler's interest in symbolism.
